exposure: Time of commencement of induction of labor (morning vs. evening)
cohort: 180 primiparous pregnant women at term (37-41 weeks gestation) with a single fetus, cephalic presentation, Bishop score ≤6, undergoing induction of labor with vaginal prostaglandins E2.
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. spontaneous vertex delivery) between morning and evening elective inductions of labor.
mod_finding: Both morning and evening elective inductions of labor were found to be equivalent in terms of cesarean section and spontaneous vertex delivery.
